notes: Meal Plan: What's planned shows the dinner calendar for the next two weeks, a row a day. Check what we need goes through the planned dinners' ingredients - tap Have or Need: Need goes on the shopping list, Have goes into the pantry on its shelf - and Claude can suggest something already in the pantry to use instead. Recipes opened from the calendar on a phone now open as their own full page (no sideways scrolling) with a Back.
